units.source_text: 当晚，所有的事情都谈好了，

en.t: That evening, everything had been settled,

units.source_text: 等到月底收下另一半金额的时候，

en.t: when the other half of the payment was received at the end of the month,

units.source_text: 就要将雏人偶交给住在横滨的美国人。

en.t: the hina dolls were to be handed over to an American living in Yokohama.

units.source_text: 什么？你问总共卖了多少钱？

en.t: What? You ask how much they sold for altogether?

units.source_text: 现在想来，真觉得难以置信，真的只有三十圆。

en.t: Looking back now, it seems truly unbelievable, but it was only thirty yen.

units.source_text: 不过，以当时的物价，这个价钱还算是不错的。

en.t: Still, by the prices of the time, that was a fairly good price.
